tools.name: validate_action
tools.description: Check if a proposed action passes all active validation rules. Returns allowed/blocked with rule violations.

context.description: Optional additional context, appended to `action` before rule matching — it can change which rules match and therefore the verdict.

tools.name: log_bypass
tools.description: Record an intentional rule bypass with justification. Cannot bypass constitutional rules.

rule_id.description: ID of the rule to bypass

tools.name: get_rules
tools.description: List active validation rules — the customer's TRUE enforced set (constitutional + recommended-default metadata on dev tier, all 69 premium rules on pro+). `category`/`preset` filter args are accepted but not applied server-side.

tools.name: update_rules
tools.description: [Planned — not yet implemented on the remote endpoint, returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED] Enable/disable is not backed by any route in this API; use set_rule_mode (shadow/advisory/enforce) instead, or the local `npx @sunaiva/gate` package.

tools.name: get_audit_log
tools.description: View recent gate decisions — blocks, warnings, passes, and bypasses.

rule_id.description: Accepted for forward-compatibility but NOT applied server-side — the backend only honors limit/cursor. Filter the returned entries client-side.

tools.name: ship_confidence_check
tools.description: [Planned — not yet implemented on the remote endpoint, returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED] Ship Confidence Gate (Rule 42) dual-tier authorization is not yet built in this backend.

command_preview.description: First 300 chars of the command that triggered the check (optional)

label.description: Human-readable label of the publish action (optional)

tools.name: audit_verify
tools.description: [Planned — not yet implemented on the remote endpoint, returns NOT_IMPLEMENTED] Forward-linked hash-chain / ed25519 audit-log verification is not yet built in this backend.

tools.name: set_rule_mode
tools.description: Set enforcement mode (shadow/advisory/enforce) for a specific rule. Requires API key (Pro+).

agent_id.description: Optional: scope override to a specific agent ID

tools.name: get_rule_modes
tools.description: List all enforcement-mode overrides configured for the authenticated customer. Requires an account (Dev+).

tools.name: reset_rule_mode
tools.description: Remove a mode override for a rule, reverting it to its default enforcement mode. Requires API key (Pro+).

rule_id.description: Rule ID whose override to remove

tools.name: add_custom_rule
tools.description: Create a custom detection rule in the backend. Requires API key (Pro+).

description.description: Rule description (required — the backend 400s on a missing/empty description)

detection_pattern.description: Compiled regex detection pattern (required — the backend 400s on a missing/empty detection_pattern). There is no 'pattern' field: 'detection_pattern' is the only field name the evaluator reads; the backend explicitly rejects 'pattern'.

tools.name: update_custom_rule
tools.description: Update an existing custom rule. Requires API key (Pro+).

detection_pattern.description: There is no 'pattern' field — 'detection_pattern' is the only field name the evaluator reads; the backend explicitly rejects 'pattern'.

tools.name: delete_custom_rule
tools.description: Delete a custom rule. Requires API key (Pro+).

tools.name: list_custom_rules
tools.description: List all custom rules for the authenticated customer. Requires API key (Pro+).

tools.name: list_presets
tools.description: List available rule preset bundles. Requires API key (Dev+).

tools.name: apply_preset
tools.description: Apply a preset bundle, activating all its included rules. Requires API key (Pro+).

preset_id.description: ID of the preset to apply
